states_row.label: The four states of a delivery
states_row.description: Four states in a column: Driving, Waiting, Unlocked, and Returning. No transitions connect them yet.
states_row.caption: Each rounded rectangle is one state: a situation the robot can be in during a delivery.

states_start.label: The initial pseudostate
states_start.description: The initial pseudostate, a small black dot, points to Driving. Waiting, Unlocked, and Returning follow below it.
states_start.caption: The black dot is not a state; its arrow leads to the first state as soon as the delivery begins.

states_end.label: The initial pseudostate and the final state
states_end.description: The black dot points to Driving, and Returning points to the final state, a bullseye. Waiting and Unlocked stand between them.
states_end.caption: The bullseye is the final state: reaching it completes this delivery's state machine.

chain_triggers.label: Transitions with triggers
chain_triggers.description: From the initial pseudostate to Driving; arrived leads from Driving to Waiting; enterPin(code) from Waiting to Unlocked; lidClosed from Unlocked to Returning; Returning leads to the final state.
chain_triggers.caption: Each arrow is a transition, labeled with the event that triggers it.
chain_triggers.source:
@startuml
layout compact
[*] --> Driving
Driving --> Waiting : arrived
Waiting --> Unlocked : enterPin(code)
Unlocked --> Returning : lidClosed
Returning --> [*]
@enduml

chain_guard.label: A transition with a guard
chain_guard.description: The chain of states, with the transition from Waiting to Unlocked labeled enterPin(code) [pin matches].
chain_guard.caption: The guard in square brackets is checked when its event arrives.
chain_guard.source:
@startuml
layout compact
[*] --> Driving
Driving --> Waiting : arrived
Waiting --> Unlocked : enterPin(code) [pin matches]
Unlocked --> Returning : lidClosed
Returning --> [*]
@enduml

chain_effect.label: Transitions with a guard and an effect
chain_effect.description: The chain of states. Waiting to Unlocked reads enterPin(code) [pin matches]; Unlocked to Returning reads lidClosed / playThanks().
chain_effect.caption: After the slash comes the effect, which runs while its transition fires.
chain_effect.source:
@startuml
layout compact
[*] --> Driving
Driving --> Waiting : arrived
Waiting --> Unlocked : enterPin(code) [pin matches]
Unlocked --> Returning : lidClosed / playThanks()
Returning --> [*]
@enduml

chain_after.label: A time event
chain_after.description: The chain of states plus a transition from Waiting to Returning labeled after(10 min).
chain_after.caption: after(10 min) is a time event: it fires 10 minutes after the robot enters Waiting, unless the robot has left by then.
chain_after.source:
@startuml
layout compact
[*] --> Driving
Driving --> Waiting : arrived
Waiting --> Unlocked : enterPin(code) [pin matches]
Unlocked --> Returning : lidClosed / playThanks()
Waiting --> Returning : after(10 min)
Returning --> [*]
@enduml

chain_when.label: A time event and a change event
chain_when.description: The chain of states with after(10 min) from Waiting to Returning, plus a transition from Driving to Returning labeled when(battery < 15%).
chain_when.caption: when(...) is a change event: it fires the moment its condition becomes true.
chain_when.source:
@startuml
layout compact
[*] --> Driving
Driving --> Waiting : arrived
Waiting --> Unlocked : enterPin(code) [pin matches]
Unlocked --> Returning : lidClosed / playThanks()
Waiting --> Returning : after(10 min)
Driving --> Returning : when(battery < 15%)
Returning --> [*]
@enduml

lid_part.label: Entry and exit behaviors of Unlocked
lid_part.description: Part of the diagram: Waiting leads to Unlocked on enterPin(code) [pin matches], and Unlocked leads to Returning on lidClosed / playThanks(). Unlocked lists entry / unlockLid() and exit / lockLid().
lid_part.caption: Only the states around the lid are shown. Behaviors inside a state sit below a line.
lid_part.source:
@startuml
layout compact
Waiting --> Unlocked : enterPin(code) [pin matches]
Unlocked --> Returning : lidClosed / playThanks()
Unlocked : entry / unlockLid()
Unlocked : exit / lockLid()
@enduml

lid_part_notify.label: Entry behaviors of Waiting and Unlocked
lid_part_notify.description: The same part of the diagram, with Waiting now listing entry / notifyCustomer().
lid_part_notify.caption: An entry behavior runs on every way into its state.
lid_part_notify.source:
@startuml
layout compact
Waiting --> Unlocked : enterPin(code) [pin matches]
Unlocked --> Returning : lidClosed / playThanks()
Waiting : entry / notifyCustomer()
Unlocked : entry / unlockLid()
Unlocked : exit / lockLid()
@enduml

returning_part.label: A do activity and a completion transition
returning_part.description: Part of the diagram: Unlocked leads to Returning on lidClosed / playThanks(). Returning lists do / driveToBase(), and an unlabeled arrow leads from Returning to the final state.
returning_part.caption: Only the end of the delivery is shown. The unlabeled arrow fires when driveToBase() is done.
returning_part.source:
@startuml
layout compact
Unlocked --> Returning : lidClosed / playThanks()
Returning --> [*]
Unlocked : entry / unlockLid()
Unlocked : exit / lockLid()
Returning : do / driveToBase()
@enduml

waiting_wrong_arrow.label: A wrong PIN drawn as a self-transition
waiting_wrong_arrow.description: Part of the diagram around Waiting, which lists entry / notifyCustomer(). An arrow leaves Waiting and returns to it, labeled enterPin(code) [pin wrong] / beep(). Waiting also leads to Unlocked on enterPin(code) [pin matches] and to Returning after(10 min).
waiting_wrong_arrow.caption: Only Waiting and its transitions are shown. An arrow back to the same state is a self-transition.
waiting_wrong_arrow.source:
@startuml
layout compact
Waiting --> Unlocked : enterPin(code) [pin matches]
Waiting --> Returning : after(10 min)
Waiting --> Waiting : enterPin(code) [pin wrong] / beep()
Waiting : entry / notifyCustomer()
@enduml

waiting_internal.label: A wrong PIN as an internal transition
waiting_internal.description: Waiting lists entry / notifyCustomer() and the internal transition enterPin(code) [pin wrong] / beep(). It leads to Unlocked on enterPin(code) [pin matches] and to Returning after(10 min).
waiting_internal.caption: An internal transition is written inside its state and never leaves it.
waiting_internal.source:
@startuml
layout compact
Waiting --> Unlocked : enterPin(code) [pin matches]
Waiting --> Returning : after(10 min)
Waiting : entry / notifyCustomer()
Waiting : enterPin(code) [pin wrong] / beep()
@enduml

waiting_extend.label: An internal transition and a self-transition
waiting_extend.description: Waiting lists entry / notifyCustomer() and enterPin(code) [pin wrong] / beep(), and has a self-transition labeled extendWait. It leads to Unlocked on enterPin(code) [pin matches] and to Returning after(10 min).
waiting_extend.caption: extendWait leaves Waiting and enters it again; the wrong PIN never leaves.
waiting_extend.source:
@startuml
layout compact
Waiting --> Unlocked : enterPin(code) [pin matches]
Waiting --> Returning : after(10 min)
Waiting --> Waiting : extendWait
Waiting : entry / notifyCustomer()
Waiting : enterPin(code) [pin wrong] / beep()
@enduml

battery_three.label: Three low-battery transitions
battery_three.description: Driving leads to Waiting on arrived, and Waiting to Unlocked on enterPin(code) [pin matches]; Unlocked lists exit / lockLid(). Driving, Waiting, and Unlocked each have an arrow to Returning labeled when(battery < 15%).
battery_three.caption: Only the low-battery transitions and the path between the three states are shown.
battery_three.source:
@startuml
layout compact
[*] --> Driving
Driving --> Waiting : arrived
Waiting --> Unlocked : enterPin(code) [pin matches]
Driving --> Returning : when(battery < 15%)
Waiting --> Returning : when(battery < 15%)
Unlocked --> Returning : when(battery < 15%)
Unlocked : exit / lockLid()
@enduml

delivering_group.label: The composite state Delivering
delivering_group.description: A composite state named Delivering contains Driving, Waiting, and Unlocked. Its own black dot points to Driving, arrived leads to Waiting, and enterPin(code) [pin matches] leads to Unlocked, which lists exit / lockLid(). The outer black dot points to the border of Delivering.
delivering_group.caption: An arrow to the border of a composite state enters through its inner black dot.

delivering_border.label: A transition from the border of Delivering
delivering_border.description: The composite state Delivering contains Driving, Waiting, and Unlocked. One arrow labeled when(battery < 15%) leads from the border of Delivering to Returning.
delivering_border.caption: Only the low-battery transition leaves the composite here. It applies to every substate.

whole.label: The whole delivery state machine
whole.description: The initial pseudostate leads to Driving. Driving leads to Waiting on arrived and to Returning on when(battery < 15%). Waiting lists entry / notifyCustomer() and enterPin(code) [pin wrong] / beep(); it has a self-transition extendWait and leads to Unlocked on enterPin(code) [pin matches] and to Returning after(10 min). Unlocked lists entry / unlockLid() and exit / lockLid() and leads to Returning on lidClosed / playThanks(). Returning lists do / driveToBase() and leads to the final state.
whole.caption: The whole diagram, before grouping states into a composite state.
whole.source:
@startuml
layout compact
[*] --> Driving
Driving --> Waiting : arrived
Waiting --> Unlocked : enterPin(code) [pin matches]
Waiting --> Waiting : extendWait
Unlocked --> Returning : lidClosed / playThanks()
Waiting --> Returning : after(10 min)
Driving --> Returning : when(battery < 15%)
Returning --> [*]
Waiting : entry / notifyCustomer()
Waiting : enterPin(code) [pin wrong] / beep()
Unlocked : entry / unlockLid()
Unlocked : exit / lockLid()
Returning : do / driveToBase()
@enduml

cancel_answer.label: Cancel transitions
cancel_answer.description: Driving leads to Waiting on arrived, and Waiting to Unlocked on enterPin(code) [pin matches]. Driving and Waiting each have an arrow to Returning labeled cancel / refund(). Unlocked has no cancel arrow.
cancel_answer.caption: Only the path between the states and the two new cancel transitions are shown; inside Delivering they leave the same two states.
cancel_answer.source:
@startuml
layout compact
[*] --> Driving
Driving --> Waiting : arrived
Waiting --> Unlocked : enterPin(code) [pin matches]
Driving --> Returning : cancel / refund()
Waiting --> Returning : cancel / refund()
@enduml

cards.title: Driving
cards.text: You type your PIN early: nothing happens, and the lid stays locked.

cards.title: Waiting at your door
cards.text: You type the same PIN: the lid unlocks.

cards.title: The states of what?
cards.text: One robot during one delivery: every possible run, not one recording.

cards.title: Allowed
cards.text: Cancel while the robot is driving or waiting.

cards.title: Not allowed
cards.text: Cancel once the lid is open.

cards.title: What cancel does
cards.text: Refund the order and send the robot back to its base.

cards.title: States
cards.text: Rounded rectangles named for situations, from the black dot to the bullseye.

cards.title: Transitions
cards.text: trigger [guard] / effect; an event with no matching arrow is discarded.

cards.title: Inside a state
cards.text: entry, exit, and do behaviors, plus internal transitions that never leave.

cards.title: Composite states
cards.text: Substates under one border; a border transition leaves any of them.
